key_insight: Polygenic risk is not confined to single diagnoses; it overlaps across brain disorders and helps shape both neuropathology and neuropsychiatric symptoms.
clinical_relevance: This could improve how brain disorders are stratified and understood, supporting more personalized research into diagnosis, prognosis, and symptom patterns.
method: Integrated genotype, clinical, and post-mortem neuropathology data
Compared disease-specific polygenic risk scores across disorders and phenotypes
evidence_signal: The study used a deeply phenotyped cohort of 2,553 donors and found cross-disorder enrichment of genetic risk, including in C9orf72-related frontotemporal lobar degeneration.
watch_item: Findings come from post-mortem brain bank data, so broader clinical validation is needed before translation to routine care.
paper_title: Dynamic interplay of polygenic risk across brain disorders, neuropathological endophenotypes, and neuropsychiatric symptoms
